goal: One simple PSTE production surface with exactly two visible paths: AUTOMATIK and KURZER_DIENSTWEG.

paths.AUTOMATIK: Process existing stored potential in small resumable batches and hand accepted items to normal production.
paths.KURZER_DIENSTWEG: Accept manual topics without new DataForSEO research and hand accepted items to normal production.

database_policy: No full backlog rebuild for a normal run.
No permanent duplicate inventory when the authoritative live structure can be read on demand.
Only process the current bounded batch.
performance_policy: No repository-wide or database-wide scan when the current batch can be checked directly.
No extra workflow, shadow path or duplicate state store.
output_policy: Exactly one normal production handoff per run.
architecture_rule: KISS: existing components stay internal; do not create a new parallel production architecture.
source_rule: Never build a new PSTE version from an unproven or reconstructed source.

TARIFRECHNER_VERSICHERUNG.rule: 500-800 words; explain protection/benefits before calculator and result/exclusions after it.

TARIFRECHNER_KOSTEN.rule: 500-800 words; explain budget/own funds/term/rate/total cost before calculator and financing result after it.

special_manual_profiles.common: No DataForSEO, no invented figures, no provider/calculator name in title, central placeholder only, no repeated series template.
